summary.name: VNote
summary.one_liner: VNote is a free, open-source, Qt-based Markdown note-taking application that stores notes as local files and runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
use_cases: take and organize Markdown notes locally
write diagrams and math in notes
sync notes across devices via WebDAV or Git
manage notes as files on disk
summary.what_it_does: VNote is a Markdown-focused note-taking app that keeps each notebook as a directory of files on the local disk, with optional note-body encryption. It offers in-place and side-by-side live preview, syntax highlighting, an interactive outline, image management, math, and diagrams via PlantUML, Graphviz, and Mermaid. Notes can be organized into unlimited folder levels, tagged, accessed quickly, and tracked by history, and external files can be explored and edited directly. Sync options include folder synchronization, built-in Git, WebDAV, and Jianguoyun. Power-user features include Vi mode, tabs and window splits, fuzzy search, and customization through themes, styles, and shortcuts.
notable: Notes stored as plain files in local directories, one notebook per directory
Built-in mind map editor, Markdown presentations, and diagram support (PlantUML, Graphviz, Mermaid)
Vi mode, tabs and window splits, and fuzzy search and jump
Licensed under GNU LGPLv3 and built with Qt and C++
caveats: Documentation covers VNote 4.9.1; features may differ in other versions
